This means for example that you should walk at an easier pace, or start to limit the times you are running or using stairs. You can even try to limit the amount of hard floor surfaces you walk on, like concrete, asphalt and marble. Another thing you can do to help your knees is wear shoes that have good padding and support. You can also elevate your knees when you are lying in bed or sitting down, as this can help too. Another idea to reduce swelling is to eat a diet that is higher in healthy fats, but lower in sugar and starch.
